problem: Unrelated portal, website and Netlify-function changes could trigger Supabase preview work, while external projection systems such as Notion could become accidental synchronous dependencies as the agent fabric grows.
root_cause: Environment-specific verification was not narrow enough: the repository Supabase preview workflow watched non-Supabase paths, and there was no machine-enforced invariant keeping Notion out of merge/deploy/readback workflows.
prevention: Trigger the repository Supabase preview contract only when supabase/** or the preview workflow itself changes.
Configure the Supabase GitHub integration with Automatic branching plus Supabase changes only before treating hosted preview branches as a required signal.
Never use the current divergent Supabase migration history as authority for automatic bulk repair; reconcile actual schema and history before migration repair.
Keep Notion as an explicit projection/synchronization surface and outside Required test, production deploy, and production readback.
Serialize production database migration application from main; parallel agents use isolated preview environments only for database-relevant changes.

evidence.docs_authority: Supabase GitHub integration supports Automatic branching with Supabase changes only
